newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei seen moving narrowly, upside capped.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei seen moving narrowly, upside capped.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's benchmark is likely to move narrowly on Wednesday, supported psychologically by another record high on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
But they said there were few fresh factors to stoke buying and gains were likely to be capped.

On Tuesday, the Nikkei average snapped a three-session losing streak helped by a slight weakening of the yen, which helped blue-chip shares to revive. It rose 148.72 points or 0.75 percent to close at 19,853.89.
Its September futures ended 150 points higher at 19,920.

"The market is waiting for the May current account data and any effect it may have on currencies," said a market analyst at a second-tier brokerage. "If the yen strengthens, the blue chips which rebounded on Tuesday will probably be sold."
The figures are due to be released at 8.50 a.m. (2350 GMT Tuesday).
